business_summary: Shanxi Blue Flame Holding Company Limited engages in the exploration, development, and utilization of coal mine gas. It is also involved in coalbed methane sales, gas control, and coalbed methane engineering design consulting and construction services, as well as road freight transportation services. The company was formerly known as Taiyuan Coal Gasification Company, Limited and changed its name to Shanxi Blue Flame Holding Company Limited in May 2017. Shanxi Blue Flame Holding Company Limited was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Taiyuan, China.
business_summary_ko: Shanxi Blue Flame Holding Company Limited는 탄광가스의 탐사, 개발 및 활용에 종사하고 있습니다. 또한 석탄층 메탄 판매, 가스 제어, 석탄층 메탄 엔지니어링 설계 컨설팅 및 건설 서비스는 물론 도로 화물 운송 서비스에도 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Taiyuan Coal Gasification Company, Limited로 알려져 있었으며 2017년 5월에 Shanxi Blue Flame Holding Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Shanxi Blue Flame Holding Company Limited는 1998년에 설립되었으며 중국 타이위안에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
